lead: Full-Stack JavaScript architect and Team Lead. I specialize in designing and delivering SaaS platforms and marketplaces from scratch to production.
seoTitle: About Palisoft — Full-Stack JavaScript Development Studio
seoDescription: The studio of Yuri Palienko: 10+ years in development, 4+ years as a team lead. SaaS platforms, marketplaces and AI agents — from architecture to production.
paragraphs: 10+ years in development, 4+ years as a Team Lead. Deep expertise in backend architecture with Node.js and NestJS, event-driven systems and high-load solutions.
For four years I led a distributed team in Rome: architecture decisions, code review, mentoring. Kept the platform stable under growing load as it scaled to 500+ corporate clients.
These days I build my own products in EdTech, PropTech and SaaS, plus open source: palistor (a declarative MVVM framework for React) and paliproxy.
A separate focus is AI agents in production: a harness with tools, subagents and a memory system for managing an application and its data.
